ayahs.transliteration: natlū ʿalayka min naba-i mūsā wafir'ʿawna bil-ḥaqi liqawmin yu'minūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি মূসা ও ফিরআউনের কাহিনী হতে কিছু তোমার কাছে সত্যিকারভাবে বিবৃত করছি বিশ্বাসী সম্প্রদায়ের উদ্দেশ্যে।
ayahs.translation_en: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
ayahs.conventional_en: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমি মূসা ও ফিরআউনের কাহিনী হতে কিছু তোমার কাছে সত্যিকারভাবে বিবৃত করছি বিশ্বাসী সম্প্রদায়ের উদ্দেশ্যে।
ayahs.meta_bn: ইতিহাসের সত্য ঘটনা বিশ্লেষণ করলে সামাজিক ন্যায়বিচার ও একনায়কতন্ত্রের পতনের শিক্ষা স্পষ্ট হয়।

ayahs.transliteration: inna fir'ʿawna ʿalā fī l-arḍi wajaʿala ahlahā shiyaʿan yastaḍʿifu ṭāifatan min'hum yudhabbiḥu abnāahum wayastaḥyī nisāahum innahu kāna mina l-muf'sidīna
ayahs.translation_bn: বস্তুতঃ ফেরাউন দেশে উদ্ধত হয়ে গিয়েছিল আর সেখানকার অধিবাসীদেরকে বিভিন্ন শ্রেণীতে বিভক্ত করে তাদের একটি শ্রেণীকে দুর্বল করে রেখেছিল, তাদের পুত্রদেরকে সে হত্যা করত আর তাদের নারীদেরকে জীবিত রাখত; সে ছিল ফাসাদ সৃষ্টিকারী।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বস্তুতঃ ফেরাউন দেশে উদ্ধত হয়ে গিয়েছিল আর সেখানকার অধিবাসীদেরকে বিভিন্ন শ্রেণীতে বিভক্ত করে তাদের একটি শ্রেণীকে দুর্বল করে রেখেছিল, তাদের পুত্রদেরকে সে হত্যা করত আর তাদের নারীদেরকে জীবিত রাখত; সে ছিল ফাসাদ সৃষ্টিকারী।
ayahs.meta_bn: জনগণকে বিভক্ত করে একটি শ্রেণীকে পদ্ধতিগতভাবে দুর্বল করা এবং ভবিষ্যৎ নেতৃত্বকে ধ্বংস করা স্বৈরাচারের সনাতন কৌশল।
ayahs.meta_en: Divide-and-conquer social stratification paired with targeted demographic suppression defines despotic rule.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ: exalted himself in the land; شِيَعًا (shiya'an): factions/castes; يَسْتَضْعِفُ: systematically oppresses.

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! Pharaoh exalted himself in the earth and made its people castes. A tribe among them he oppressed, killing their sons and sparing their women. Lo! he was of those who work corruption.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Truly Pharaoh elated himself in the land and broke up its people into sections, depressing a small group among them: their sons he slew, but he kept alive their females: for he was indeed a maker of mischief.
english_translations.shakir: Surely Firon exalted himself in the land and made its people into parties, weakening one party from among them; he slaughtered their sons and let their women live; surely he was one of the mischiefmakers.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh dominated the land and divided its inhabitants into different groups, suppressing one group by killing their sons and keeping their women alive. He was certainly an evil-doer.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, Fir'aun (Pharaoh) exalted himself in the land and made its people sects, weakening (oppressing) a group (i.e. Children of Israel) among them, killing their sons, and letting their females live. Verily, he was of the Mufsidun (i.e. those who commit great sins and crimes, oppressors, tyrants, etc.).
english_translations.arberry: Now Pharaoh had exalted himself in the land and had divided its inhabitants into sects, abasing one party of them, slaughtering their sons, and sparing their women; for he was of the workers of corruption.

ayahs.transliteration: wanurīdu an namunna ʿalā alladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū fī l-arḍi wanajʿalahum a-immatan wanajʿalahumu l-wārithīna
ayahs.translation_bn: দেশে যাদেরকে দুর্বল করে রাখা হয়েছিল আমি তাদের প্রতি অনুগ্রহ করার ইচ্ছে করলাম, আর তাদেরকে নেতা ও উত্তরাধিকারী করার (ইচ্ছে করলাম)।
ayahs.translation_en: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
ayahs.conventional_en: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
ayahs.conventional_bn: দেশে যাদেরকে দুর্বল করে রাখা হয়েছিল আমি তাদের প্রতি অনুগ্রহ করার ইচ্ছে করলাম, আর তাদেরকে নেতা ও উত্তরাধিকারী করার (ইচ্ছে করলাম)।
ayahs.meta_bn: প্রাকৃতিক ঐতিহাসিক নিয়মে নিপীড়িত জনগোষ্ঠীই কালক্রমে সংগ্রামের মধ্য দিয়ে নেতৃত্ব ও সভ্যতার উত্তরাধিকারী হয়।
ayahs.meta_en: Cosmic historical laws inevitably overturn entrenched despotism in favor of emancipated underclasses.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: اسْتُضْعِفُوا (ustuḍ'ifū): were oppressed/weakened; أَئِمَّةً (a'immatan): leaders/guides; الْوَارِثِينَ: inheritors.

english_translations.pickthall: And We desired to show favour unto those who were oppressed in the earth, and to make them examples and to make them the inheritors,

ayahs.transliteration: wanumakkina lahum fī l-arḍi wanuriya fir'ʿawna wahāmāna wajunūdahumā min'hum mā kānū yaḥdharūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর (ইচ্ছে করলাম) তাদেরকে দেশে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করতে, আর ফেরাউন, হামান ও তাদের সৈন্য বাহিনীকে দেখিয়ে দিতে যা তারা তাদের (অর্থাৎ মূসার সম্প্রদায়ের) থেকে আশঙ্কা করত।
ayahs.translation_en: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
ayahs.conventional_en: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর (ইচ্ছে করলাম) তাদেরকে দেশে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করতে, আর ফেরাউন, হামান ও তাদের সৈন্য বাহিনীকে দেখিয়ে দিতে যা তারা তাদের (অর্থাৎ মূসার সম্প্রদায়ের) থেকে আশঙ্কা করত।
ayahs.meta_bn: স্বৈরাচারী শাসক নিজের ক্ষমতা বাঁচাতে যে বিদ্রোহের ভয় পায়, প্রকৃতির নিয়মে ঠিক সেই বিদ্রোহেই তার পতন ঘটে।
ayahs.meta_en: The defensive atrocities enacted by paranoid tyrants ultimately precipitate the very collapse they sought to suppress.

english_translations.sahih_international: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-awḥaynā ilā ummi mūsā an arḍiʿīhi fa-idhā khif'ti ʿalayhi fa-alqīhi fī l-yami walā takhāfī walā taḥzanī innā rāddūhu ilayki wajāʿilūhu mina l-mur'salīna
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি মূসার মায়ের প্রতি ওয়াহী করলাম যে, তাকে স্তন্য পান করাতে থাক। যখন তুমি তার সম্পর্কে আশঙ্কা করবে, তখন তুমি তাকে দরিয়ায় নিক্ষেপ করবে, আর তুমি ভয় করবে না, দুঃখও করবে না, আমি তাকে অবশ্যই তোমার কাছে ফিরিয়ে দেব আর তাকে রসূলদের একজন করব।
ayahs.translation_en: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
ayahs.conventional_en: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমি মূসার মায়ের প্রতি ওয়াহী করলাম যে, তাকে স্তন্য পান করাতে থাক। যখন তুমি তার সম্পর্কে আশঙ্কা করবে, তখন তুমি তাকে দরিয়ায় নিক্ষেপ করবে, আর তুমি ভয় করবে না, দুঃখও করবে না, আমি তাকে অবশ্যই তোমার কাছে ফিরিয়ে দেব আর তাকে রসূলদের একজন করব।
ayahs.meta_bn: চরম বিপদের মুখেও সত্যের প্রতি অগাধ আস্থা রেখে পদক্ষেপ নিলে পরম সুরক্ষার দুয়ার উন্মোচিত হয়।
ayahs.meta_en: Intuitive divine inspiration guides vulnerable actors through high-risk preservation protocols.

english_translations.sahih_international: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
english_translations.pickthall: And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him and, when thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grieve. Lo! We shall bring him back unto thee and shall make him (one) of Our messengers.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: So We sent this inspiration to the mother of Moses: "Suckle (thy child), but when thou hast fears about him, cast him into the river, but fear not nor grieve: for We shall restore him to thee, and We shall make him one of Our messengers."
english_translations.shakir: And We revealed to Musa's mothers, saying: Give him suck, then when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear nor grieve; surely We will bring him back to you and make him one of the apostles.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We inspired Moses' mother saying, "Breast-feed your son. When you become afraid for his life, throw him into the sea. Do not be afraid or grieved for We shall return him to you and make him a Messenger."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And We inspired the mother of Musa (Moses), (saying): "Suckle him [Musa (Moses)], but when you fear for him, then cast him into the river and fear not, nor grieve. Verily! We shall bring him back to you, and shall make him one of (Our) Messengers."
english_translations.arberry: So We revealed to Moses' mother, 'Suckle him, then, when thou fearest for him, cast him into the sea, and do not fear, neither sorrow, for We shall return him to thee, and shall appoint him one of the Envoys.'

ayahs.transliteration: fal-taqaṭahu ālu fir'ʿawna liyakūna lahum ʿaduwwan waḥazanan inna fir'ʿawna wahāmāna wajunūdahumā kānū khāṭiīna
ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর ফেরাউনের লোকজন তাকে উঠিয়ে নিল যাতে সে তাদের জন্য শত্রু হতে ও দুঃখের কারণ হতে পারে। ফেরাউন, হামান ও তাদের বাহিনীর লোকেরা তো ছিল অপরাধী।
ayahs.translation_en: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
ayahs.conventional_en: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতঃপর ফেরাউনের লোকজন তাকে উঠিয়ে নিল যাতে সে তাদের জন্য শত্রু হতে ও দুঃখের কারণ হতে পারে। ফেরাউন, হামান ও তাদের বাহিনীর লোকেরা তো ছিল অপরাধী।
ayahs.meta_bn: স্রষ্টার কৌশল এমন যে, অত্যাচারী নিজের হাতেই তার শাসন অবসানের কারণকে সযত্নে লালন করে।
ayahs.meta_en: Systemic irony places the agent of civilizational overthrow directly within the palace of the oppressor.

ayahs.translation_bn: মূসার মায়ের অন্তর বিচলিত হয়ে উঠল। সে তো তার পরিচয় প্রকাশ করেই ফেলত যদি না আমি তার চিত্তকে দৃঢ় করতাম যাতে সে আস্থাশীল হয়।
ayahs.translation_en: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

ayahs.translation_en: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.

ayahs.translation_bn: সে শহরে প্রবেশ করল যখন সেখানের লোকেরা অসতর্ক অবস্থায় ছিল। তখন সে দু’জন লোককে সংঘর্ষরত অবস্থায় পেল। একজন তার দলের, অপরজন তার শত্রুদলের। তখন তার দলের লোকটি তার শত্রুদলের লোকটির বিরুদ্ধে তার কাছে সাহায্যের আবেদন জানালো। তখন মূসা তাকে ঘুসি মারল এবং হত্যা করে ফেলল। মূসা বলল- ‘এটা শয়ত্বানের কাজ। সে নিশ্চয় প্রকাশ্য শত্রু, গুমরাহকারী।’
ayahs.translation_en: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."

ayahs.meta_bn: ন্যায়ের পক্ষে থাকতে গিয়েও আবেগের বশে মাত্রাতিরিক্ত শারীরিক শক্তি প্রয়োগ বড় বিপর্যয় ডেকে আনতে পারে, যা দ্রুত অনুধাবন করা ব্যক্তিত্বের সততার পরিচায়ক।

english_translations.yusuf_ali: And he entered the city at a time when its people were not watching: and he found there two men fighting,- one of his own religion, and the other, of his foes. english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He entered the city without the knowledge of its inhabitants and found two men fighting each other. One was his follower and the other his enemy. english_translations.mohsin_khan: And he entered the city at a time of unawareness of its people, and he found there two men fighting, - one of his party (his religion - from the Children of Israel), and the other of his foes. english_translations.arberry: And he entered the city, at a time when its people were unheeding, and found there two men fighting; the one was of his own party, and the other was of his enemies. ayahs.conventional_en: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he said, "O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the amenders."

ayahs.meta_en: Reckless allies can publicly weaponize private missteps, compounding systemic vulnerability.

ayahs.translation_en: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.conventional_en: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.meta_bn: বাস্তব পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণ এবং একই সাথে পরম স্রষ্টার সাহায্য প্রার্থনা করাই সংকট থেকে উত্তরণের পথ।
ayahs.meta_en: Combining physical tactical retreat with existential reliance on divine justice optimizes survival.

ayahs.translation_bn: যখন সে মাদইয়ানের কূপের কাছে পৌঁছল, সে একদল লোককে দেখল (তাদের জন্তুগুলোকে) পানি পান করাতে, তাদের ছাড়া আরো দু’জন স্ত্রীলোককে দেখল (নিজেদের পশুগুলোকে) আগলে রাখতে। মূসা জিজ্ঞেস করল- ‘তোমাদের দু’জনের ব্যাপার কী?’ তারা বলল- ‘আমরা আমাদের জন্তুগুলোকে পান করাতে পারি না যতক্ষণ না রাখালেরা (তাদের পশুগুলোকে) সরিয়ে না নেয় (পানি পান করানোর পর), আর আমাদের পিতা খুবই বয়োবৃদ্ধ।
ayahs.translation_en: And when he came to the well of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women driving back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

ayahs.meta_bn: প্রভাবশালীদের ভীড়ে যারা পিছিয়ে পড়ে, তাদের প্রতি একজন প্রকৃত সংস্কারক সর্বদা সহানুভূতিশীল দৃষ্টি দেয়।

ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর মূসা যখন মেয়াদ পূর্ণ ক’রে তার পরিবার নিয়ে যাত্রা করল, তখন সে তূর পর্বতের দিকে আগুন দেখতে পেল। সে তার পরিবারবর্গকে বলল- ‘তোমরা অপেক্ষা কর, আমি আগুন দেখেছি, আমি তোমাদের জন্য সেখান থেকে খবর আনতে পারি কিংবা জ্বলন্ত কাষ্ঠখন্ড আনতে পারি যাতে তোমরা আগুন পোহাতে পার।’

ayahs.translation_en: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...

english_translations.pickthall: Otherwise, if disaster should afflict them because of that which their own hands have sent before (them), they might say: Our Lord! Why sentest Thou no messenger unto us, that we might have followed Thy revelations and been of the believers?

english_translations.shakir: And were it not that there should befall them a disaster for what their hands have sent before, then they should say: Our Lord! why didst Thou not send to us an apostle so that we should have followed Thy communications and been of the believers!
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: to whom no warner had been sent that perhaps they might take heed, and that, on experiencing afflictions because of their own deeds, they may not say, "Lord, would that You had sent to us a Messenger so that we could follow Your revelations and become believers".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And if (We had) not (sent you to the people of Makkah) in case a calamity should seize them for (the deeds) that their hands have sent forth, they should have said: "Our Lord! english_translations.arberry: Else, did an affliction visit them for that their own hands have forwarded then they might say, 'Our Lord, why didst Thou not send a Messenger to us that we might follow Thy signs and so be among the believers?'

ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর আমার নিকট থেকে তাদের কাছে যখন সত্য আসল তখন তারা বলল- ‘মূসাকে যা দেয়া হয়েছিল তাকে কেন সেরূপ দেয়া হল না? ইতোপূর্বে মূসাকে যা দেয়া হয়েছিল তারা কি তা অস্বীকার করেনি?’ তারা বলেছিল- ‘দু’টোই যাদু, একটা আরেকটার সহায়তাকারী। আর তারা বলেছিল আমরা (তাওরাত ও কুরআন) সবই প্রত্যাখ্যান করি।’
ayahs.translation_en: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."

english_translations.sahih_international: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
english_translations.pickthall: And if they answer thee not, then know that what they follow is their lusts. And who goeth farther astray than he who followeth his lust without guidance from Allah. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But if they hearken not to thee, know that they only follow their own lusts: and who is more astray than one who follow his own lusts, devoid of guidance from Allah? for Allah guides not people given to wrong-doing.
english_translations.shakir: But if they do not answer you, then know that they only follow their low desires; and who is more erring than he who follows his low desires without any guidance from Allah? Surely Allah does not guide the unjust people.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: If they cannot meet such a challenge, know that they are only following their (evil) desires. Who strays more than one who follows his desires without guidance from God? God does not guide the unjust people.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: But if they answer you not (i.e. do not believe in your doctrine of Islamic Monotheism, nor follow you), then know that they only follow their own lusts. And who is more astray than one who follows his own lusts, without guidance from Allah? Verily! Allah guides not the people who are Zalimun (wrong-doers, disobedient to Allah, and polytheists).
english_translations.arberry: Then if they do not answer thee, know that they are only following their caprices; and who is further astray than he who follows his caprice without guidance from God? Surely God guides not the people of the evildoers.

ayahs.transliteration: walaqad waṣṣalnā lahumu l-qawla laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তাদের কাছে ক্রমাগত বাণী পৌঁছে দিয়েছি যাতে তারা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করে।
ayahs.translation_en: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমি তাদের কাছে ক্রমাগত বাণী পৌঁছে দিয়েছি যাতে তারা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করে।
ayahs.meta_bn: কুরআনের বক্তব্য বিচ্ছিন্ন নয়, বরং ঐতিহাসিক ধারাবাহিকতায় সুশৃঙ্খলভাবে সংযুক্ত।
ayahs.meta_en: The Quranic discourse is delivered in interconnected thematic coherence to facilitate human understanding.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ الْقَوْلَ: We linked the word continuously; يَتَذَكَّرُونَ: take heed, reflect.

english_translations.sahih_international: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded.
english_translations.pickthall: And now verily We have caused the Word to reach them, that haply they may give heed.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Now have We caused the Word to reach them themselves, in order that they may receive admonition.

ayahs.transliteration: alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba min qablihi hum bihi yu'minūna
ayahs.translation_bn: এর পূর্বে আমি যাদেরকে কিতাব দিয়েছিলাম তারা (অর্থাৎ তাদের কতক লোক) তাতে বিশ্বাস করে।
ayahs.translation_en: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.
ayahs.conventional_en: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এর পূর্বে আমি যাদেরকে কিতাব দিয়েছিলাম তারা (অর্থাৎ তাদের কতক লোক) তাতে বিশ্বাস করে।
ayahs.meta_bn: যাদের কাছে অতীতের বিশুদ্ধ শাস্ত্রীয় জ্ঞান রয়েছে, তারা সহজেই কুরআনের সত্যতা চিহ্নিত করতে পারে।
ayahs.meta_en: Grounding in authentic prior revelations enables objective recognition of the final divine code.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā yut'lā ʿalayhim qālū āmannā bihi innahu l-ḥaqu min rabbinā innā kunnā min qablihi mus'limīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদের নিকট যখন তা আবৃত্তি করা হয় তখন তারা বলে- আমরা এতে বিশ্বাস করি, এ সত্য আমাদের প্রতিপালকের নিকট থেকে (আগত), এর পূর্বেই আমরা আত্মসমর্পণকারী ছিলাম।
ayahs.translation_en: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [submitting to Allah]."
ayahs.conventional_en: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [submitting to Allah]."

ayahs.meta_bn: একত্ববাদ ও সত্যের প্রতি সমর্পণ কোনো নতুন ধর্ম নয়, বরং এটি মানব ইতিহাসের চিরন্তন ধারা।
ayahs.meta_en: Embracing the Quran is the natural continuation of a lifelong commitment to cosmic monotheism.

ayahs.transliteration: ulāika yu'tawna ajrahum marratayni bimā ṣabarū wayadraūna bil-ḥasanati l-sayi-ata wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদেরকে তাদের পারিশ্রমিক দু’বার দেয়া হবে যেহেতু তারা ধৈর্য ধারণ করেছে এবং তারা ভাল দিয়ে মন্দের প্রতিহত করে আর আমি তাদেরকে যে রিযক দিয়েছি তাত্থেকে তারা ব্যয় করে।
ayahs.translation_en: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.
ayahs.conventional_en: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তাদেরকে তাদের পারিশ্রমিক দু’বার দেয়া হবে যেহেতু তারা ধৈর্য ধারণ করেছে এবং তারা ভাল দিয়ে মন্দের প্রতিহত করে আর আমি তাদেরকে যে রিযক দিয়েছি তাত্থেকে তারা ব্যয় করে।
ayahs.meta_bn: আঘাতের বদলে সদয় ব্যবহার ও ইতিবাচক কর্ম দিয়ে বৈরিতা দূর করাই ইসলামের উন্নততম নৈতিক কৌশল।
ayahs.meta_en: Neutralizing aggressive disruption with constructive virtue diffuses societal toxicity and earns double reward.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā samiʿū l-laghwa aʿraḍū ʿanhu waqālū lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum salāmun ʿalaykum lā nabtaghī l-jāhilīna

english_translations.arberry: Thou guidest not whom thou likest, but God guides whom He wills, and knows very well those that are guided.

ayahs.translation_bn: তারা বলে- ‘আমরা যদি তোমার সাথে সৎপথের অনুসরণ করি তাহলে আমরা আমাদের দেশ থেকে উৎখাত হব।’ আমি কি তাদের জন্য এক নিরাপদ ‘হারাম’ প্রতিষ্ঠিত করিনি যেখানে সর্বপ্রকার ফলমূলের নজরানা আসে আমার পক্ষ থেকে রিযক স্বরূপ? কিন্তু তাদের অধিকাংশই তা জানে না।

ayahs.translation_bn: আমি কত জনপদকে ধ্বংস করেছি যারা তাদের (ভোগবিলাসপূর্ণ) জীবনে চরম উৎকর্ষ সাধন করেছিল। এই তো তাদের বাসস্থান, তাদের পর এগুলোতে খুব অল্প লোকই বসবাস করেছে, অবশেষে আমিই মালিক রয়েছি।

english_translations.sahih_international: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?
english_translations.pickthall: And whatsoever ye have been given is a comfort of the life of the world and an ornament thereof; and that which Allah hath is better and more lasting. Have ye then no sense?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: The (material) things which ye are given are but the conveniences of this life and the glitter thereof; but that which is with Allah is better and more enduring: will ye not then be wise?
english_translations.shakir: And whatever things you have been given are only a provision of this world's life and its adornment, and whatever is with Allah is better and more lasting; do you not then understand?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whatever you (people) have been given are only the means for enjoyment and beauty of the worldly life, but the means of enjoyment (which you will receive from God) in the life to come will be better and everlasting. Will you then not take heed?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And whatever you have been given is an enjoyment of the life of (this) world and its adornment, and that (Hereafter) which is with Allah is better and will remain forever. Have you then no sense?
english_translations.arberry: Whatever thing you have been given is the enjoyment of the present life and its adornment; and what is with God is better and more enduring.

ayahs.translation_bn: আমি যাকে ও‘য়াদা দিয়েছি, কল্যাণের ও‘য়াদা আর সেটা সে পাবেও, সে কি ঐ ব্যক্তির সমান যাকে আমি পার্থিব জীবনের ভোগ-সম্ভার দিয়েছি, অতঃপর ক্বিয়ামতের দিন তাকে হাজির করা হবে (অপরাধীরূপে)?
ayahs.translation_en: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?
ayahs.conventional_en: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?

ayahs.meta_en: Short-term hedonic optimization pales against the sustainable thermodynamic returns of righteous action.

english_translations.sahih_international: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?
english_translations.pickthall: Is he whom We have promised a fair promise which he will find (true) like him whom We suffer to enjoy awhile the comfort of the life of the world, then on the Day of Resurrection he will be of those arraigned?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Are (these two) alike?- one to whom We have made a goodly promise, and who is going to reach its (fulfilment), and one to whom We have given the good things of this life, but who, on the Day of Judgment, is to be among those brought up (for punishment)?
english_translations.shakir: Is he to whom We have promised a goodly promise which he shall meet with like him whom We have provided with the provisions of this world's life, then on the day of resurrection he shall be of those who are brought up?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Is the case of those to whom We have promised good things - which they will certainly receive in the life to come - equal to the case of those to whom We have granted the means of enjoyment in the worldly life and who will certainly be questioned about them in the life to come?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Is he whom We have promised an excellent promise (Paradise), which he will find true, like him whom We have made to enjoy the luxuries of the life of (this) world, then on the Day of Resurrection, he will be among those brought up (to be punished in the Hell-fire)?
english_translations.arberry: Will you not understand? What, is he to whom We have promised a fair promise, and he receives it, like him to whom We have given the enjoyment of the present life, then he on the Resurrection Day shall be of those that are arraigned?

english_translations.sahih_international: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allah and high above what they associate with Him.

english_translations.yusuf_ali: Thy Lord does create and choose as He pleases: no choice have they (in the matter): Glory to Allah! and far is He above the partners they ascribe (to Him)!
english_translations.shakir: And your Lord creates and chooses whom He pleases; to choose is not theirs; glory be to Allah, and exalted be He above what they associate (with Him).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord creates and chooses (to grant mercy) to whomever He wants. (In matters of guidance) they (unbelievers) do not have the choice to choose whatever they want. God is too exalted to be considered equal to anything else.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And your Lord creates whatsoever He wills and chooses, no choice have they (in any matter). Glorified be Allah, and exalted above all that they associate as partners (with Him).
english_translations.arberry: Thy Lord creates whatsoever He will and He chooses; they have not the choice. Glory be to God! High be He exalted above that they associate!

ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা কি ভেবে দেখেছ আল্লাহ যদি তোমাদের উপর রাতকে ক্বিয়ামতের দিন পর্যন্ত স্থায়ী করতেন তাহলে আল্লাহ ছাড়া কোন ইলাহ্ আছে কি যে তোমাদেরকে আলো এনে দিত? তবুও কি তোমরা কর্ণপাত করবে না?
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"

english_translations.sahih_international: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.
english_translations.pickthall: He said: I have been given it only on account of knowledge I possess. Knew he not that Allah had destroyed already of the generations before him men who were mightier than him in strength and greater in respect of following? The guilty are not questioned of their sins.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He said: "This has been given to me because of a certain knowledge which I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed, before him, (whole) generations,- which were superior to him in strength and greater in the amount (of riches) they had collected? but the wicked are not called (immediately) to account for their sins.
english_translations.shakir: He said: I have been given this only on account of the knowledge I have. Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of the generations those who were mightier in strength than he and greater in assemblage? And the guilty shall not be asked about their faults.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "I have received this wealth because of my knowledge." Did he not know that God had destroyed many generations that lived before him who were stronger than him in power and people? (There will be no need) to ask the criminals what sins they have committed, (for the angels already know them)
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He said: "This has been given to me only because of knowledge I possess." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him generations, men who were stronger than him in might and greater in the amount (of riches) they had collected. But the Mujrimun (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, etc.) will not be questioned of their sins (because Allah knows them well, so they will be punished without account).
english_translations.arberry: He said, 'What I have been given is only because of a knowledge that is in me.' What, did he not know that God bad destroyed before him generations of men stronger than he ill might, and more numerous in multitude? And yet the sinners shall not be questioned concerning their sins.

ayahs.transliteration: fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi fī zīnatihi qāla alladhīna yurīdūna l-ḥayata l-dun'yā yālayta lanā mith'la mā ūtiya qārūnu innahu ladhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin
ayahs.translation_bn: কারূন শান-শওকাতের সাথে তার সম্প্রদায়ের সামনে হাজির হল। যারা পার্থিব জীবন কামনা করে তারা বলে উঠল- ‘হায়! কারূনকে যা দেয়া হয়েছে আমাদের জন্যও যদি তা হত! সত্যই সে মহা ভাগ্যবান ব্যক্তি।’
ayahs.translation_en: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."
ayahs.conventional_en: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."
ayahs.conventional_bn: কারূন শান-শওকাতের সাথে তার সম্প্রদায়ের সামনে হাজির হল। যারা পার্থিব জীবন কামনা করে তারা বলে উঠল- ‘হায়! কারূনকে যা দেয়া হয়েছে আমাদের জন্যও যদি তা হত! সত্যই সে মহা ভাগ্যবান ব্যক্তি।’
ayahs.meta_bn: সম্পদের বাহ্যিক চাকচিক্য দেখে সাধারণ মানুষ বিভ্রান্ত হয়, কিন্তু সচেতন জ্ঞানী ব্যক্তিরা এর পেছনের ক্ষণস্থায়িত্ব চিনে নেয়।
ayahs.meta_en: Public display of wealth generates intense consumerist envy among individuals lacking spiritual discernment.

english_translations.shakir: So he went forth to his people in his finery. Those who desire this world's life said: O would that we had the like of what Qaroun is given; most surely he is possessed of mighty good fortune.

english_translations.arberry: So he went forth unto his people in his adornment. Those who desired the present life said, 'Would that we possessed the like of that Korah has been given! Surely he is a man of mighty fortune.

english_translations.pickthall: As for that Abode of the Hereafter We assign it unto those who seek not oppression in the earth, nor yet corruption. The sequel is for those who ward off (evil).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: That Home of the Hereafter We shall give to those who intend not high-handedness or mischief on earth: and the end is (best) for the righteous.
english_translations.shakir: (As for) that future abode, We assign it to those who have no desire to exalt themselves in the earth nor to make mischief and the good end is for those who guard (against evil)

english_translations.arberry: That is the Last Abode; We appoint it for those who desire not exorbitance in the earth, nor corruption. The issue ultimate is to the godfearing.

ayahs.translation_bn: যে কেউ সৎকর্ম নিয়ে হাজির হবে তার জন্য আছে আরো উত্তম প্রতিদান। আর যে মন্দ কাজ নিয়ে হাজির হবে তাহলে যারা মন্দকর্ম করে তাদেরকে তাদের কাজ অনুপাতেই শাস্তি দেয়া হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.

english_translations.pickthall: And let them not divert thee from the revelations of Allah after they have been sent down unto thee; but call (mankind) unto thy Lord, and be not of those who ascribe partners (unto Him).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And let nothing keep thee back from the Signs of Allah after they have been revealed to thee: and invite (men) to thy Lord, and be not of the company of those who join gods with Allah.
english_translations.shakir: And let them not turn you aside from the communications of Allah after they have been revealed to you, and call (men) to your Lord and be not of the polytheists.

english_translations.mohsin_khan: And let them not turn you (O Muhammad SAW) away from (preaching) the Ayat (revelations and verses) of Allah after they have been sent down to you, and invite (men) to (believe in) your Lord [i.e. in the Oneness (Tauhid) of Allah (1) Oneness of the Lordship of Allah; (2) Oneness of the worship of Allah; (3) Oneness of the Names and Qualities of Allah], and be not of Al-Mushrikun (those who associate partners with Allah, e.g. polytheists, pagans, idolaters, those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allah and deny the Prophethood of Messenger Muhammad SAW).
english_translations.arberry: Let them not bar thee from the signs of God, after that they have been sent down to thee. And call upon thy Lord, and be thou' not of the idolaters.

ayahs.transliteration: walā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā ilāha illā huwa kullu shayin hālikun illā wajhahu lahu l-ḥuk'mu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহর সঙ্গে অন্য কোন ইলাহকে ডেকো না, তিনি ছাড়া সত্যিকারের কোন ইলাহ নেই, তাঁর (সত্তা) ছাড়া সকল কিছুই ধ্বংসশীল। বিধান তাঁরই, আর তাঁর কাছেই তোমাদেরকে ফিরিয়ে আনা হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.

ayahs.meta_bn: পরম অস্তিত্বের সত্যতা: আল্লাহর পবিত্র সত্তা ব্যতীত মহাবিশ্বের প্রতিটি বস্তুর অনিবার্য বিনাশ

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
english_translations.pickthall: And cry not unto any other god along with Allah. There is no Allah save Him. Everything will perish save His countenance. His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And call not, besides Allah, on another god. There is no god but He. Everything (that exists) will perish except His own Face. To Him belongs the Command, and to Him will ye (all) be brought back.
english_translations.shakir: And call not with Allah any other god; there is no god but He, every thing is perishable but He; His is the judgment, and to Him you shall be brought back.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not worship anything besides God. He is the only God. Everything will be destroyed except God. To Him belongs Judgment and to Him you will all return.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And invoke not any other ilah (god) along with Allah, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). Everything will perish save His Face. His is the Decision, and to Him you (all) shall be returned.
english_translations.arberry: And call not upon another god with God; there is no god but He. All things perish, except His Face. His is the Judgment, and unto Him you shall be returned.
